artists: Contains artists. Column Name is artist name. Links to albums via ArtistId.
albums: Contains albums. Links to artists via ArtistId, and to tracks via AlbumId.
tracks: Contains individual tracks (TrackId). Links to albums via AlbumId.
students: Contains student records. Column attendance_percentage is overall attendance. Absent percentage is (100.0 - attendance_percentage).
attendance: Contains daily attendance events with student_id, date, and status ('Present' or 'Absent').
